ops.body: Investigation (2026-07-14, fusekit @ v1.2.0): the task's literal Option A — a vmstress mode spawning REAL go-nfsv4 via setsid — is impossible: go-nfsv4 is spawned only by libfuse-t inside the cgo -tags fuse holder, and vmstress is pure-Go CGO_ENABLED=0 (scripts/vm/push.sh:46, internal/carcass/reap_darwin.go:18-23). The real incident maps to the graceful path: unmountAll keeps busy mounts ("mount(s) survived the final sweep", mountd/server.go:294) and logs "mountd stopped" (:299), THEN the process dies. Decision: implement BOTH (a) a decoy-orphan vmstress arm — a go-nfsv4-named decoy setsid'd with a real carcass mountpoint as last argv, deterministically exercising ReapOrphanedServers' full carcass-gate + cross-gen scan + kill-time reconfirm — and (b) a graceful-SIGTERM-under-busy arm (open fd holds the mount busy → SIGTERM → "mountd stopped" → process exit) to empirically settle whether a REAL orphan survives and exercise the setpgid gate. Sibling scenario beside repro-holder-crash-orphan.sh. In flight on branch fk-vm-orphan.
